name: Rain on Glass
description: The scene behind the window fogged by a blur, with rain droplets running down the pane. Each droplet refracts the scene and leaves a trail of beads that fade as it falls. Droplet size, rain amount, fall speed and refraction strength are this pack's own parameters. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the rain.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Fog radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene fogs behind the glass (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the rained-on glass

parameters.name: Droplet size
parameters.description: Overall size of the droplets. Larger values mean bigger drops

parameters.name: Rain amount
parameters.description: How much of the pane carries droplets

parameters.name: Fall speed
parameters.description: How quickly the droplets run down the pane

parameters.name: Refraction
parameters.description: How strongly droplets bend the scene behind them. It scales the droplet's own geometric offset, so 40 is that offset unchanged and 80 is twice it

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the blur that hides banding in smooth gradients

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts

parameters.name: Mirror at the edge
parameters.description: Where the bend reaches past the pane's edge, fold the backdrop back inside. Left off, the bend keeps reading the captured scene beside the pane, which can make the edges look see-through
